description:
PR #404 landed the /prompts/ launch on 2026-05-14. Walking the live page
surfaced (a) a semantic conflation — "Generic / manual" was implemented
as a fallback for "no agent at all", when the user's actual intent
(Pi, OpenCode, Cline, Aider, etc.) was for Generic to be a real
coding-agent option — and (b) several rendering bugs:
  - H1 hidden behind the fixed nav (insufficient top padding).
  - Platform A/B fields leak into Test-one mode, and the single
    Platform field leaks into Compare mode, because the CSS
    `display: flex` on `.prompts-field` overrides the HTML `hidden`
    attribute set by JS.
  - MCP mode renders TWO natural-language prompt blocks (Agent prompt
    + MCP prompt) doing roughly the same job.
  - A "CLI commands" block is always shown even though the page H1 is
    about composing agent prompts.
  - Page lede ends "or run the commands yourself" — a manual-mode
    legacy.

Decisions ratified by the user before this TODO was created:
  - Agent label = "Generic" with a hint "Pi, OpenCode, Cline, Aider, …"
    visible only when Generic is selected.
  - CLI commands block fully removed; the agent prompt is the artefact.
  - Emoji glyphs on block titles are acceptable to add visual interest.
  - One PR (not split).
  - Default agent remains Generic.

Branch: `fix/landing-prompts-generic-semantics-and-layout`. Base: `develop`.

work_units.notes:
Add a CSS override so the HTML `hidden` attribute beats
`display: flex` on `.prompts-field`:

    .prompts-field[hidden],
    .prompts-block[hidden] { display: none !important; }

After this, JS toggling `el.hidden = true/false` is sufficient and
no JS-driven `display` mutation is needed.

- `landing/prompts/prompts.css`: add a `.prompts-main::before`
  radial-gradient overlay using `--accent-primary`/`--accent-secondary`
  rgba tints, mirroring the landing `.hero::before` pattern.
- Promote `.prompts-header, .prompts-form, .prompts-output` to
  `position: relative; z-index: 1;` so the gradient sits behind
  the panels.
- Leave existing panel fills (`--bg-secondary`) alone — they are
  already strong enough against the new background.

- `landing/prompts/index.html`: delete `<div id="block-cli">` and
  `<div id="block-mcp-prompt">` entirely. Rename the surviving
  MCP block heading from "MCP server setup" to "MCP server config".
- `landing/prompts/prompts.js`: remove the rendering paths for
  both deleted blocks; collapse `renderOutput()` so it manages
  only `block-prompt`, `block-mcp-setup`, and `block-cloud-safety`.
